evals.prompt: A calendar logs 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' whenever an all-day row appears. The callback reads the row width and sets padding on the same container. Review it without hiding window errors.
evals.expected_output: Maps the observed-size to padding-write feedback cycle, captures repeated error and final geometry, considers a convergent expected-size guard or justified post-paint write, and adds a resize/content regression.
expectations: The response identifies the observed container's width-to-padding write as a concrete feedback cycle rather than treating the browser message as noise.
Diagnosis preserves and counts the error while recording callback iterations and final geometry; it does not silence window errors as the fix.
The proposed repair makes the write converge through an expected-size guard or justifies a post-paint write that no longer changes the observed size indefinitely.
The regression changes both viewport or container size and row content, then verifies stable final geometry and no repeated loop error.

evals.prompt: A component uses ResizeObserver, disconnects it on unmount, never writes layout from the callback, and repeated resize tests have stable geometry and no error. Flag it because ResizeObserver can loop.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the API-name-only finding and requires a demonstrated cycle, wrong box, stale target, cleanup leak, or user-visible effect.
expectations: The response rejects an API-name-only finding when no callback write, error, unstable geometry, stale target, or cleanup leak is demonstrated.
Disconnecting on unmount and stable repeated-resize results are treated as positive controls rather than suspicious source patterns.
The response names the additional runtime evidence required before filing a defect, such as a feedback cycle, wrong observed box, stale observation, or user-visible layout failure.

evals.prompt: A child iframe posts its height to the parent, which changes the iframe height and triggers another post forever. Which skill owns the fix?
evals.expected_output: Routes the cross-document sizing protocol and stabilization contract to iframe-embed-contracts while using ResizeObserver evidence only to identify the local trigger.
expectations: The response assigns ownership of the cross-document sizing protocol and its convergence contract to iframe-embed-contracts.
ResizeObserver records are used to identify the local trigger, but changing observer scheduling alone is rejected as proof that the parent-child loop is fixed.
Verification exercises both parent and child and proves that posted sizes and iframe geometry settle instead of oscillating.
